how_to_apply: Visit the official website at www.echs.gov.in to check detailed instructions and download the application format.

No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview. Only candidates meeting the Qualitative Requirements may apply. Preference will be given to Ex-servicemen.

faq.question: Q1. What is ECHS Raipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ECHS Raipur Recruitment 2026 is a contractual hiring notification for 14 medical and non-medical positions across polyclinics in Raipur, Bilaspur, and Jagdalpur.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under ECHS Raipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 14 vacancies are announced for various posts including Medical Officer, Dental Officer, Nursing Assistant, Lab Technician, Pharmacist, Female Attendant, Safaiwala, and Chowkidar.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for ECHS Raipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form is 22 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Medical Officer?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree with a minimum of 03 years of work experience after internship (additional qualifications in medicine/surgery are preferable).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for ECHS Raipur posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit varies by post and type of employment service, ranging from 53 years to 68 years.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for ECHS Raipur Recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for ECHS Raipur vacancies?
faq.answer: Candidates must download the application format from the official website, attach self-attested photocopies of required documents, and submit it by Post or Hand to OIC, Stn HQ (ECHS Cell) Raipur.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for ECHS Raipur?
faq.answer: The selection process consists of an interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for Medical Officer in ECHS Raipur?
faq.answer: The notified remuneration for Medical Officer is Option 1: Fixed Rs. 85,000/- or Option 2: Payment as per new policy letter dated 24 July 2025 for ESM only.

faq.question: Q10. When will the interview be held?
faq.answer: Interview dates will be intimated telephonically or by e-mail to eligible candidates.
